Page7 selectable axis prose inside the preserved original Form uses two source-bbox-only language masks; exact10.759679794311523pt source metadata and perpendicular baseline/rotation are retained. Native [hour] and [Bq/m³] units, every red point/tick/grid/curve and source Form remain fixed.

Page8 both complete piecewise LHS/CMEX brace/value columns remain at exact source coordinates. Only source if prose labels become 조건:, with the complete native condition expressions moved horizontally at their source font sizes/baselines.

Page9 Korean particle after native N uses a whitespace anchor but style is independently guarded to actual adjacent SFRM1200 prose every on the same original baseline and size; original N/beta math stays native.
Page10 original italic emphasis proportional and at the same time maps to Korean 비례 and 동시에; no artificial word break in 비례함을.

Pages2/3/7/9/10 tiny source-descender contacts cleared only with bounded horizontal row offsets or natural same-meaning prose; no point-size/baseline change. Page6 critical-value phrase reworded without changing the native vcrit expression.
Original last-page printed \end{document} artifact retained as original fixed native text.
